race.comment: IMMORTAL BLISS (2) won the Belmont Newmarket impressively two back before a disappointing performance at Kalgoorlie last start in the Golden Saddle. Back to 1000m is a query, but he's been freshened since and he can storm over the top to get back to winning ways. TALKANCO (8) surprised in The Quokka, running just 0.7L off the winner before heading to the Goodwood in Adelaide where she wasn't beaten far. Nice trial coming into this behind a smart type, and the inside draw is a big tick. Reunites with Brad Parnham and she can resume on a winning note. TWISTED STEEL (4) almost beat IMMORTAL BLISS when first-up last campaign and looks in good order judging by his latest trial win. Should land in a good spot from the barrier and with the ear muffs coming off, he's primed for a bold showing. PISANELLO (3) creates some interest for the new stable.
